BiblicalUsage: Daniel says the light dwells with God who reveals deep and secret things, and the queen tells Belshazzar that light and understanding and wisdom were found in Daniel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe light belongs to God before it belongs to any man: it dwells with Him, and Daniel carries it only because God gave it, and the queen saw in Daniel what belongs to God alone.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
